text.aria-label: Title text 'Follow-up figure B: Blending B0 with climatology lowers long-lead error more than any lag arm shown does'
text.tspan: Follow-up figure B: Blending B0 with climatology lowers long-lead error
more than any lag arm shown does

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: arms that use climatology, shown as the error minus B0's. The climatology of every top-panel arm is the median power of the plant's calendar month and hour from months outside the scored block (out-of-fold). Those months include months after the target day, which a live service would not have. Adding climatology as a column (CL) leaves the 95% interval across zero at every lead-day shown, so CL does not clearly beat B0. Bottom: lag arms. W7 and Q30 read recent days. N2 reads one random day from months not being scored, and N2-3 reads three such days, giving N2-3 as many columns as W7. N2 and N2-3 therefore show what a lag with no recent information gains. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Zero is B0. All rows are post hoc: written after the first run's results were known. Arms. CL: B0 plus the climatology as a column. W7+CL: W7 plus the climatology as a column. B0xCL: B0 blended half and half with the climatology, with no fit. W7xCL: W7 blended half and half with the climatology, with no fit. climatology: the median power of the plant's calendar month and hour, from months outside the scored block, with no fit. W7: the minimum, maximum, and mean of the same hour over the last 7 whole days. Q30: the 30-day 90th percentile and median of the same hour. N2: a random day from months not being scored (a null control). N2-3: three random-day lags, as wide as W7.'
text.tspan: Top: arms that use climatology, shown as the error minus B0's. The climatology of every top-panel arm is the median

Bottom: lag arms. W7 and Q30 read recent days. N2 reads one random day from months not being scored, and N2-3 reads
three such days, giving N2-3 as many columns as W7. N2 and N2-3 therefore show what a lag with no recent
information gains. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Zero is B0.
All rows are post hoc: written after the first run's results were known.
Arms. CL: B0 plus the climatology as a column. W7+CL: W7 plus the climatology as a column. B0xCL: B0 blended half
and half with the climatology, with no fit. W7xCL: W7 blended half and half with the climatology, with no fit.
climatology: the median power of the plant's calendar month and hour, from months outside the scored block, with no
fit. W7: the minimum, maximum, and mean of the same hour over the last 7 whole days. Q30: the 30-day 90th
percentile and median of the same hour. N2: a random day from months not being scored (a null control). N2-3: three
random-day lags, as wide as W7.
